pullRequests.title: Fix RAC1 item randomizer empty vendors and Gadgetron PDA crashes
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: fix/item-randomizer-rac1-empty-vendor
pullRequests.body:
Fixes RAC1 item-randomizer vendor crashes and access to an unowned starting Bomb Glove.
Buying the final available vendor row starts the normal closing transition while retaining a valid row for the purchase handler. Empty filtered physical vendors lose interaction until stock returns. The Gadgetron PDA refuses to open without ammunition rows, including ammunition generated for owned weapons. Removes the fabricated Bomb Glove ammunition fallback, adds NTSC-U and PAL v2.00 item-price-table…

pullRequests.title: Add Archipelago starting options and shuffled gold-weapon cases
pullRequests.author: SavedbyBlood9
pullRequests.head: feat/archipelago-starting-weapons
pullRequests.body:
Adds two starting-game options and randomized gold-weapon case purchases to the RAC1 Archipelago mod.
Starting game
starting_weapons replaces keep_starting_gear: vanilla keeps Bomb Glove, shuffled randomizes the starting location without guaranteeing a weapon, non_broken chooses a normal or gold weapon except R.Y.N.O., and unrestricted chooses any normal or gold weapon. Gold variants are eligible even when gold-case shuffling is off. Starting rewards swap with the corresponding base-weapon slot…

pullRequests.body:
A new native mod, cheats, for Ratchet & Clank (PAL and NTSC-U), built with the pinned SDK 1.14.4 for interface 1.12 (the current launcher's).
What it does
In a level, Pause > Options > Cheats opens a page of the game's own menus:



Row





Invincibility
Hits take no health (rac1.player.take_damage)


Infinite ammo

Infinite oxygen

pullRequests.title: fix(lock-strafe): 1.2.1 stops, flips, fixed cameras, running jump
pullRequests.author: nickyyOO
pullRequests.head: fix/lock-strafe-stop-and-twist
pullRequests.body:
Before: a strafe ended with a push forward, flips went diagonally, Kalebo III's wall camera made him aim at the wall, and he turned in the running jump.
After: he moves along the stick, flips go straight, no strafe under a level's fixed camera (L2 still taken), and he faces ahead in the running and double jumps.
Tested: unit and load tests (fail without the fixe

pullRequests.author: farfeduc
pullRequests.head: fix/multiplayer-pause-stick
pullRequests.body:
The bug
On the pause menu's pages (Options > Multiplayer, and the Team tools, Party rules and Remove pages opened from it), moving the cursor with the left stick can act on the row it arrives at:

the game's pad reading (func_002181F0, games/rac1 src/game/system/pad.c) turns the stick into Left or Right as soon as one axis leans 0x30 from the centre, whatever the other does, so pushing it down a little off straight is also Left or Right;
